real_defects.issue: parsePlayers accepted an empty 'can:' (or a 'not:'/'can:' pair covering every position) as 'allowed nowhere', so the child silently sat the whole game and the only hint was a misleading 'sits two periods in a row' warning (repro: 'Ann | can:' with GK, DEF x2 -> Ann played 0 of 4). Now a parse error names the child; failing-first test in calc.test.mjs.

test_a_lock_is_kept_while_a_git_process_runs_in_the_repo (from #17478) was red on GitHub's runner and green locally: it copied the sleep binary as 'git-sleeper', and a multicall coreutils (uutils) dispatches on argv[0], so it exited at once. The test went on without the process anyway (its wait loop never asserted). It failed ventures-tests' unwired checks for every PR. Now it uses a /bin/sh script (comm is named after the script), asserts the process is visible, and kills the process group.
